set.body: Evidence: GeneralizedLowRankProgram exposes evaluate over caller-supplied factors, while the generic PalmProblem and PalmSolver have no public GLRM adapter. Smallest remediation: compile a validated GLRM objective into an admitted solver problem and return a typed fitted artifact. Acceptance: fit at least mixed masked quadratic plus logistic data; retain learned row codes and decoder, observation and program identities, trace, solver receipt, achieved guarantee, and fitted latent encoder; fail closed for unsupported losses or capabilities; add independent oracle tests on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Make GeneralizedLowRankProgram executable and evidence-bearing
